spec_match.rationale: Uses the declarative windowfeatures attribute on real <a target=_blank> links and a <form>, and shows IDL reflection on a/area/form, the rel=opener rule and a JS enhancement.

interactive.rationale: Clickable result links, a rel=opener toggle, a splitsize slider, a search form and per-result JS buttons, with live reflection readouts and reports.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the practical-product card (SERP use case).

edge_cases.rationale: Shows noopener-by-default vs rel=opener and the unknown-attribute fallback. The <base target> interaction and <area> clicks are not exercised.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the spec/explainer sections it exercises.

conformance.rationale: Reflection/IDL assertions on a/area/form fail honestly today.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: links and the form opened ordinary tabs (no opener by default; opener with rel=opener); the JS popup=0,split enhancement opened a tab with opener; a.windowFeatures undefined; mobile overflow found (93px) and fixed (grid minmax(0,1fr)), re-measured at 0px; no console errors. the API is absent in Chromium 153 even with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features / --enable-blink-features=WindowOpenSplitTab, so only the legacy branch was observed, and headless has no split-view UI.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts reflection branch and each opened result's report.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons override both background and color; verdict colours use emerald-dark/rose on stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Real links (middle-click and context menu preserved), labelled search, checkbox and range, live status.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at both classes after the overflow fix.

openQuestions.title: Add <base target> and <area> cases
openQuestions.detail: The explainer says a windowfeatures split/popup implies _blank ahead of <base target>. Add an image-map <area> and a base-target iframe case.

guidanceConsulted.query: window.open popup features link opener noopener
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Be deliberate about opener relationships; use noopener/COOP when the opened page should not control the opener.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: noopener and rel=opener are explicit, visible toggles, and the copy explains that a split keeps the opener by default.

guidanceConsulted.query: form controls radio group fieldset legend accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related radios/checkboxes in fieldset+legend and label every control.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Option groups use fieldset/legend or wrapping labels; range inputs have associated label+output.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status live region announce async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results via polite live regions; keep native buttons/labels; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/outputs are role=status or aria-live=polite; all controls are native buttons/inputs with visible text labels and a 3px focus outline; min 44px targets.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic grid tracks (minmax(min(100%, Xrem), 1fr)) and wrap long monospace strings so nothing overflows at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Card grids use minmax(min(100%,…),1fr); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3.

summary: The declarative SERP story is built on real links and degrades exactly as the explainer promises.
